from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, identified by its title and what other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers this document references in its bibliography (filter to provided papers downstream)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
